result.title: AlphaDefect: Expert-Level AI for Slay the Spire 2
result.summary: Slay the Spire 2 (STS2) is a single-player deck-building game that requires long-term planning under heavy randomness. We present AlphaDefect, an expert-level AI system for STS2: for each character, one network trained with proximal policy optimization (PPO) makes every decision of a run, in combat and outside it. At the highest difficulty, Ascension 10, on two versions of the game current in November 2026 and on test seeds not played in training, AlphaDefect wins 62-77% of runs across six characters with greedy play and 68-80% with test-time search, after 1.3 to 6.7 billion decisions of training per character; runs uploaded by human players of all levels are won 11-20% of the time at the same difficulty. The networks read the game as entity records that identify each card, relic and enemy through a learned embedding and attributes from the game data, together with consequences of public information computed by the engine. Ablations show how much the agent depends on this encoding: without these identities, the network did not win a single run, and without the computed consequences it won 8.3 points fewer. To our knowledge, AlphaDefect is the strongest publicly reported STS2 agent as of November 2026.

AI.brief_summary: AlphaDefect 为《Slay the Spire 2》每个角色训练单一 PPO 网络统一处理战斗内外决策，在最高难度与未见种子上以贪心及测试时搜索取得 62–80% 通关率，并用消融表明实体身份编码与引擎计算后果对性能至关重要。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「实体记录＋学习嵌入」的状态编码及去掉身份后零胜率的消融，可能为 LVR 中视觉细节与实体关系能否保留在内部状态、信息坍缩诊断提供类比线索；测试时搜索的收益也可供核查动态计算与停止决策的成本权衡，但领域相距较远。
